description: Rules and references for building embedded Shopify app UI (App Home) with Polaris 2.0 web components (s-page, s-table, s-modal, s-section...). Use when writing or reviewing any s-* element, a page, table, modal, form, empty or error state, the Polaris script tag or polarisUrl, polaris-types in tsconfig, or when a Polaris prop type-checks but does nothing on screen. Unofficial community kit, not affiliated with Shopify.
proven: Polaris 2.0 release candidate (script polaris-2.0-rc.js, @shopify/polaris-types 2.0.0-rc.3), React 18.3, React Router app template; rules marked proven were observed on that stack in 2026-08..2026-10. See docs/PROVEN-ON.md
